blocks.text: South Korean actor Park Bo-gum achieved a new milestone as he officially became a licensed hairdresser after passing the national certification examination on his second attempt. The Korea Times reported, citing tvN, that Park recently passed South Korea’s national technical qualification examination for general hairdressing ahead of the November premiere of the second season of his reality show, “The Village Barber 2.” The achievement came after the actor failed the practical portion of the examination during the first season of the show. Park continued training while preparing for the show’s second season and eventually succeeded on his second try. The national […]...
